source.name: Como 1907 - Revolut becomes Como 1907's Official Front-of-Shirt Partner
source.quote: Revolut becoming the club’s Official Front-of-Shirt Partner from the 2026/27 season onward

source.name: Como 1907 - Como 1907 and Uber Extend Partnership with New Four-Year Agreement
source.quote: Uber will also appear on the back of the Como 1907 shirt for all Serie A and Coppa Italia matches for the first two seasons of the partnership

source.name: Como 1907 - PokerStarsNews continues partnership with Como 1907
source.quote: PokerStarsNews will remain the club's official sleeve partner, with its logo appearing on the sleeves of the men's first team's shirts

source.name: Como 1907 - Como 1907 and adidas unveil the 2026/27 home jersey
source.quote: Como 1907 and adidas today unveil the club's new home jersey for the 2026/27 season, designed by Chief Brand Officer Rhuigi Villaseñor with adidas
source.note: Kit maker, named in the club's home-jersey launch; not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense.

summary: adidas home shirt: Revolut on the front, Uber on the back, PokerStarsNews on the sleeves. Revolut is rated none; Uber is a listed US company with no state holder at 5% or more; PokerStarsNews is run by TSG Platforms (Ireland), a Flutter Entertainment subsidiary - also listed, with no state holder found.
